{{EnemiesAppearing|Those Guys|Shibalien|Cosmic Cyclone}} '''Black Hole Rising (Insane)''' is the 6th [[:Category:Cyclone Stages|Cyclone Stage]]. It was added in [[Version 4.0 Update|Version 4.0]] and appears every Thursday. Upon completion, players have a 30% chance to unlock [[Drumcorps Cat (Rare Cat)|Drumcorps Cat]]. {{Stage Info |stage name = [[File:rc021.png]] [[File:Mapsn066 00 s en.png]] |stage location = [[File:Mapname066 s en.png]] |energy = 200 |catamins = [[Catamin]] [A] x2 |enemy castle hp = 999,000 HP |enemies = {{Magnification|Those Guys|100% |Shibalien|200% |Shibalien|400% |Shibalien|600% |Shibalien|800% |Shibalien|1,000% |Shibalien|1,200%}} |boss = {{Magnification|Cosmic Cyclone|100%}} |treasure = - [[Drumcorps Cat (Rare Cat)|Drumcorps Cat]] (30%, 1 time) |XP = 3,800 XP |width = 5,600 |max enemies = 8 |script = 進撃のブラックホール 超激ムズ |romaji = Shingeki no Burakkuhōru Chō Geki Muzu |star = 1 |event-chapter = Dimension of Despair |difficulty = ★7 |prev stage = N/A |next stage = N/A }} ==Battleground== *Infinite [[Those Guys]] spawn, delay 5.33~16.67 seconds160f~500f. *10 [[Shibalien]]s (200%) spawn after 100 seconds3,000f, delay 4~16 seconds120f~480f. *10 [[Shibalien]]s (400%) spawn after 133.33 seconds4,000f, delay 4~16 seconds120f~480f. *10 [[Shibalien]]s (600%) spawn after 166.67 seconds5,000f, delay 4~16 seconds120f~480f. *10 [[Shibalien]]s (800%) spawn after 213.33 seconds6,400f, delay 4~16 seconds120f~480f. *10 [[Shibalien]]s (1,000%) spawn after 280 seconds8,400f, delay 4~16 seconds120f~480f. *Infinite [[Shibalien]]s (1,200%) spawn after 360 seconds10,800f, delay 0.07~6 seconds2f~180f. *1 [[Cosmic Cyclone]] spawns as the boss after 33.33 seconds1,000f. ==Strategy== The [[Anti-unstarred Alien Treasures]] from [[Into the Future]] are almost required for this stage. 400% is probably the minimum, but 600% is ideal. This Cyclone has longer range than most other Cyclones, can decrease the attack power of Cat Units, and has a damage boost when its health is low, making it a formidable opponent. Like all Cyclones, Cosmic Cyclone is very weak to crowd-control. The best options to defeat it using crowd-control are [[Surfer Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Seafarer Cat]] and [[Psychocat (Rare Cat)|Corrupted Psychocat]], as both outrange the Cyclone. Cosmic Cyclone has another weakness: its minimal support. Shibaliens and Those Guys are the only other enemies in this stage, which are weak peons. With luck, your crowd-controllers can easily stunlock the Cyclone, leaving other units to take it down. ==Missions== {{MissionTable |{{Mission|Cyclone Festival Missions
